spans.s: galita, of Buddhaʼs voice, perhaps fluent: Mv 〔i.315.3〕 [] ˚tam (so or ˚tam mss.; Senart em. gaditaṃ, but his note retracts the em.) āviṣṭaṃ bhāṣati, metr. dubious; 〔i.171.11〕 galita-pada-saṃcayavatī, of Buddhaʼs voice. It would perhaps be rash to read agalita, which is used in Pali in the sense of (not dropping,) fluent, distinct, agreeable (CPD). Relation of the two forms obscure.
gallī (v.l. gallikā; unrecorded; cf. ardha-gallī), some sort of vehicle: Mv 〔ii.434.8〕 (prose). Doubtless = AMg. (etc.) gaḍḍī, cart.
